description: Use when you need to inspect a JWT without a key: decoded header and payload, alg, kid, iat/nbf/exp as ISO times and whether it is expired now. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /util/jwt-decode, $0.001 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
name: util_jwt_decode
title: Util JWT decode
